Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

District.reason: District Line: Minor delays between Earl's Court and Upminster due to an earlier trespasser on the track at Hammersmith. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Elizabeth line.reason: Severe delays between Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4 and MINOR DELAYS between Hayes & Harlington and Reading due to vandalism to railway equipment in the Paddington area. MINOR DELAYS between Whitechapel and Shenfield due to signal failure at Gidea Park. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Lioness.reason: Lioness Line: No service between Watford Junction and Willesden Junction and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to a sewage leak on the track at Watford High Street. London Underground is accepting tickets via reasonable routes.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Baker Street and Aldgate and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to a collapsed drain on the track at Baker Street. Tickets being accepted on London Buses and Chiltern railway services.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: No service between King's Cross St. Pancras and Arnos Grove and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line while emergency services deal with a casualty on the track. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Great Northern, London Overground and South Western Railway services.

Weaver.reason: Weaver Line: Severe delays between Liverpool Street and Chingford while we conduct a safety inspection of the track at Wood Street. London Underground is accepting tickets via reasonable routes. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
